description: This file defines a PHP class 'GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate' which extends 'GenericDateDisplayField'. It provides functionality for handling date display fields with aggregation capabilities in report generation, including mapping configuration, setting display fields, and generating query select parts.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: Class for date display fields with aggregation in reports, supporting configuration mapping and custom select part generation.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets entity alias, field, and aggregate based on display field's alias.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with this display field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates the SQL select part for this field including the aggregation.
